claims.newSentence: Lupus UK says the outlook for survival has improved in recent years, and that with early treatment lupus may settle and ultimately go into remission. The course is variable: some people have one flare, while others have periodic increased disease activity followed by remission. A rheumatologist or lupus specialist can discuss what this means for an individual.
